findings.evidence: The sparse-input assertion only checks "Does not claim a file was saved to `/mnt/user-data/outputs/`." An answer could ask a question, fabricate slides and claim a save elsewhere while satisfying both assertions.
findings.fix: Assert that the response stops after one focused clarification question, produces no deck and makes no successful-save claim to any path.

findings.evidence: `section.lead { border-bottom: 8px solid var(--color-hr); }` follows the equally specific `section.final { border-bottom: none; }`. Consequently, the `<!-- _class: lead final -->` closing-title example recommended in SKILL.md retains its border. The dark and colorful templates have the same cascade.
findings.fix: In the basic, dark and colorful templates, move the final-border override after the lead rule or add a later `section.lead.final { border-bottom: none; }` rule.

findings.evidence: The only workflow routes are "New deck" and "Existing deck", although the description explicitly includes "custom Marp theme CSS". A request to create a reusable theme stylesheet without creating slides has no matching route; the new-deck route instead requires a concrete topic and audience and proceeds to slide creation.
findings.fix: Add a theme-CSS-only route that loads references/theme-css-guide.md, creates or edits the requested stylesheet without demanding a deck topic or generating a presentation, and validates it through a small preview deck when rendering is available.
